svg.text: 57 of 300 labelled windows are wrong; the error rate over all 15,813 windows is 19.0% (14.8% to 23.9%, valid at
How wrong the map is. (a) The 300 labelled windows of a random sample from the map's 15,813 windows on its 128 x
128 window grid, shown on the map's confidence rank (faded); green where the label agrees with the map (243),
magenta where it does not (57). (b) The map's error rate over all its windows, 19.0%; valid at every sample
size: 14.8% to 23.9%; the interval this design earns: 14.8% to 23.9%. The intervals assume the labels are right.
Windows are drawn by row and column, row 0 at the top; no coordinates are drawn.
